title: Read CBOR records across incoming chunks
goal: Decode a finite CBOR measurement array while retaining only incomplete token bytes between incoming chunks.

selectionNotes: Incremental reading requires Lax mode. Retain unconsumed token bytes, mark actual final input, and bound token/result sizes separately.

runtime.name: .NET
runtime.reason: This edition uses .NET 11 library APIs; the .NET 10 code is a comparison, not a catalogue route.

sdk.name: .NET SDK
sdk.reason: Build the declared net11.0 sample with the .NET 11 SDK.

language.name: C#
language.reason: The canonical net11.0 project selects the .NET 11 default C# 15 language mode.

packages.name: System.Formats.Cbor
packages.reason: Incremental reader APIs are in System.Formats.Cbor 11; exact RC2 pins are recorded in sample evidence.

prerequisites: Use a net11.0 console project with LangVersion=15.0 and a System.Formats.Cbor 11 package reference. Include the imports stated in the recipe.
constraints: Incremental mode requires Lax; Strict/Canonical modes reject a non-final initial block in RC2. NeedsMoreData means obtain a larger valid window, not retry the same read in a busy loop. SlideData must preserve unconsumed bytes; a chunk can end inside one token. This narrow parser accepts one definite/indefinite measurement array of Int32 values, rejects other states and trailing roots, and retains all decoded results in a List: it does not promise bounded total result memory. Bound incoming chunk/token size and total measurements at the application boundary for untrusted data. Lax is a conformance choice, not permission to trust malformed or unlimited input. Default nesting limits/options are a separate goal; this single-level parser does not change them.
stabilityLimitations: RC2 verification; GA reconciliation remains pending.
